set firewall family inet filter junos-security-test term t1 from protocol icmp
set firewall family inet filter junos-security-test term t1 then policer junos-security-pol
set firewall family inet filter junos-security-test term t1 then count junos-security-cnt
set firewall family inet filter junos-security-test term t1 then accept
set firewall family inet filter junos-security-test term rest then accept
set firewall policer junos-security-pol if-exceeding bandwidth-limit 1m
set firewall policer junos-security-pol if-exceeding burst-size-limit 15k
set firewall policer junos-security-pol then discard
